error.place-start-first: Every player places a castle or a port first.
error.invalid-target: That is not a valid target.
error.not-neighbor: It must be a neighboring intersection.
error.cannot-pay: You cannot pay for it, even with your gold.
error.point-taken: There is already a building there.
error.road-taken: There is already a road there.
error.road-not-connected: A road must start at one of your buildings or roads.

error.need-road-there: A settlement moves only along a road.
help.setup: Click any free intersection to place your first building: a port on the coast, a castle inside. It is free.
help.play: Roads: click a dashed mark on a cell side. Settlements: click a circle next to your road. Rings around buildings: promote, trade, move a settlement, or attack a rival building. Troops: click a cell next to your castle to recruit; click your troops, then a highlighted cell to move (only cells next to your buildings) or a red one to attack (your troops already there help). Your selected cell menu also attacks rivals inside it, with all your troops. 8 troops in a cell block it for the rivals. Esc cancels.
info.blocked: Blocked by {player}: only their buildings collect here
log.siege-lose: {player} fails to topple a {building} of {owner} ({mine} vs {theirs})
log.eliminated: {player} has no buildings left: out of the game
error.no-castle: That cell does not touch one of your castles.
error.cell-full: There is no room there (8 troops per cell).
error.not-enough-troops: You do not have enough troops there.
error.no-defender: There are no enemy troops there.
error.not-your-building: Attack from one of your buildings.
error.no-rival-building: There is no rival building there.
error.building-too-far: Your building must share a cell with the one you attack.
move.wheel: Mouse wheel: more or fewer troops
move.retarget: Click another cell to change the destination, or this one again to accept.
siege.parts: You: building +{mine}, troops +{mySupport} · Defender: building +{theirs}, troops +{theirSupport}
siege.destroy: If you win, the settlement is destroyed.
siege.downgrade: If you win, it becomes a settlement.
error.move-needs-building: Troops only move to cells next to your buildings.
error.inside-all: From inside the cell, all your troops there fight.
attack.inside-all: All your {count} troops in the cell fight; if you lose, they all fall.
attack.helpers: +{count} of your troops already in the cell join the fight; if you lose, they fall too.
